decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith ( 0000-00-GL Rev F, received 22nd July 2010) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - No amplified  music shall be played at the premises.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted as a community facility shall not be carried on outside the following times; Monday to Saturday 9am to 11pm and Sundays and Bank Holidays 9am to 10pm.

Condition : 6 - The premises shall be used as a community facility and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D2) of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
description: Change of use of premises to a community centre.
